correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 36–67 give the correct analytic coefficient. The KKT multipliers on an active contiguous block are weighted prefix residual sums, positive for data strictly decreasing inside the block; separate block means yield strictly slack interblock constraints, so any contiguous averaging partition occurs locally on an open cell. A step across edge i yields either the unchanged step (different blocks) or a single fractional block average (same block), with mass fraction (Q_q-Q_i)/(Q_q-Q_p) on block [p+1,q]. Weighted variation of this response is exactly the chord ordinate at Q_i, including boundary pooling when a nonexistent edge has weight zero. Steps span the quotient by constants isometrically as a weighted l1 basis. Thus the maximum piece norm is the chord/weight maximum, and each chord is witnessed in a strict cell. Continuity and segment subdivision (or approximation by generic segments) globalize. The maximum chord ordinate is the upper convex hull of the plotted points, for which fixed-abscissa extrema have at most two endpoints; adjacent nonincreasing slopes are equivalent to equality with the majorant. At n=4, a_i=1 and w=(1,epsilon,1), the middle majorant ordinate is 1, so the coefficient diverges as epsilon tends to zero. Independent replay `python3 -I /workspace/review-work/replay.py 3` constructed hulls by a monotone stack and used max-min interval formulas, not the supplied PAVA checker, confirming 160 exact attaining pairs and 2,400 exact pair inequalities. Frozen verification code inspected, not executed; finite replay is not the proof.

evidence: The frozen paper identifies Yang–Barber's NUNA as the unit-mass contraction baseline. Positive rational observation masses can be represented by replication under unit mass; fitting a repeated input is constant on each duplicate group because averaging any such group preserves order and improves squared loss. A concave weight interpolation on the replicated chain proves the mass-concave contraction statement, extending by continuity to positive real masses. The indexed TV-denoising mass-concavity result c426456313be gives fusion and pathwise jump criteria for a different operator.
